title: Dev
html:
Dev is short for Developer.

These are the wonderful people that make Dungeon Runners possible!!!
The Devs for Dungeon Runners are some of the most informative people both on the forums and in-game when compared to Devs on other MMO's. They have been known to both actively play and participate in discussions on both PvP and PvE servers.

Some of the Devs are :
